capabilities: Add, edit, check and delete todos from a right-sidebar panel
Reorder todos by dragging and move them between groups
Manage multiple todo lists as markdown files with optional aliases
Tag todos with @tags and assign per-tag colors in settings
Reflect edits made to group files outside the panel
extras: Not published to the community plugin list, so it must be installed manually; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. A removed Base storage mode is ignored, though notes it created stay in the vault.
motivation: The author keeps a todo list per project in Obsidian and found switching between those files to check items off annoying, with easy reordering missing.
problem: Checking off todos spread across project files means switching between notes, and Obsidian has no panel for viewing and reordering them in one place.
summary: Sidebar panel that manages todo lists stored as checkbox lines in markdown files you choose in your vault.
